title: session-bounded-log-buckets-with-corrid-translator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: high-cardinality multi-tenant traces and long-tail sessions are causing correlation lookup hotspots and excessive KV-cache memory in the current Loki ingestion path. Objective: implement a session-bounded bucketing layer upstream of the ingest pipeline that groups events into short-lived 'session buckets' (based on session id, authenticated user id, or request-flow fingerprint), and a CorrID Translator that canonicalizes disparate correlation id formats into a stable tenant-scoped ID. Goals: reduce per-request correlation lookup latency, make rehydration/backfill cheaper, and improve ordered delivery for downstream ELK/Loki stores. Success metrics: 35% reduction in median correlation-lookup latency, 20% reduction in ingestor memory pressure at P95, and no more than 2% increase in end-to-end log ingestion latency during normal load.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after postmortem of 2026-02-18 ingest spike (link to incident notes in Confluence). Spike suggested sessionization to reduce repeated KV lookups for long-lived flows.

2026-02-25 - Jonas Keller: Completed PoC for bucket key derivation (session_id > auth_user_id > x-request-id fingerprint). PoC shows 40% fewer lookup ops in synthetic workloads. PoC branch: github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/tree/poC/session-buckets

2026-03-01 - Eng Lead (Marcos Reed): Reviewed trade-offs. Decision: session buckets will be soft-bounded (time TTL + size cap) to avoid head-of-line blocking. We accept eventual consistency for replays/backfills; strong ordering will be guaranteed only within the same bucket.
2026-03-03 - Security (Priya Singh): CorrID Translator design reviewed. Need to add tenant-scoped HMAC to canonical IDs to prevent cross-tenant guessing. Added to scope as low-cost HMAC step.

2026-03-05 - Jonas Keller: Implemented CorrID Translator (normalize, extract legacy patterns, apply tenant HMAC). Benchmarks: translator CPU adds ~0.6% of ingest CPU at 10k req/s; memory overhead negligible. Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/4123

2026-03-07 - SRE (Diego Morales): Backpressure behavior validated in staging. Under synthetic spikes we observed an increase of 8ms median ingest latency during warmup; within SLO. Noted a pathological case where extremely long sessions (>1h) keep bucket alive; introduced max-ttl of 15m by default and an admin override for VIP customers.

2026-03-09 - Design (Lina Cho): UX for Console: added 'session bucket' toggle on ingest routes, with visible bucket occupancy and TTL. Dashboard mockups uploaded to Grafana link. Please review for release notes text.

2026-03-10 - Jonas Keller: Work in progress: integration tests failing intermittently around reordering heuristics. Next steps: add deterministic sequence anchors to bucket headers and iterate on dedupe window logic. Planning canary rollout to 5% of hosts once tests green.
